biography: Ken Costello's journey began not on the polished asphalt of Silverstone, but on the muddy, winding tracks of his family's farm in rural Oxfordshire. From a young age, he was tearing around in a battered Land Rover, developing a feel for vehicle control that belied his age. His father, a former rally driver, recognized the spark and gifted him a kart for his tenth birthday. Ken quickly dominated the local karting scene, his aggressive overtaking maneuvers earning him both wins and the occasional penalty. A defining moment came at the Junior Karting National Championship where, despite starting last after a technical issue, he fought his way to second place, showcasing his relentless determination. Now, at 21, Costello is making waves in the MINI Cooper S series, his raw talent and fearless driving attracting attention from bigger teams. He's considered a rising star, but needs to temper his aggression to achieve consistent results.
drivingStyle: Costello's driving style is characterized by its aggressive and uncompromising nature. He's a late-braking specialist, often diving into corners with a ferocity that leaves rivals scrambling. While this approach yields impressive speed and daring overtakes, it also leads to occasional lock-ups and tire degradation. He thrives under pressure, often finding an extra gear when the stakes are high. Tire management, however, remains a work in progress, as his tendency to push too hard early in a stint can compromise his pace later in the race.

rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle at Brands Hatch resulted in a controversial collision, sparking a heated rivalry that extends beyond the track.
Dubois and Costello consistently compete for podium finishes, their contrasting driving styles – Dubois smooth and calculated, Costello aggressive and instinctive – creating compelling races.
Thornton, a veteran racer, has publicly criticized Costello's aggressive tactics, leading to a war of words and intense competition on the track.

quirks: Always wears a lucky wristband made from an old Land Rover seatbelt.
Listens to heavy metal music at full volume right up until the minute before getting into the car.
Refuses to eat anything green on race days.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. You go out there to win, plain and simple."
careerHighlight: Winning the MINI Cooper S Championship race at Oulton Park, overtaking two cars on the final lap with a daring move around the outside of the hairpin.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the season due to over-exuberance, costing him a shot at the championship title.
